review_mode: Two fresh Codex native reviewers supplied blind board only by leader; no answer key; native32px

scoring_policy.primary: Semantic coarse category in primary name; generic wood, hide, axe, vessel, chipped stone allowed. Does not establish exact kind or state.
scoring_policy.exact: Primary name must identify expected kind, not merely list it as an alternative. GroundAxe/CuredHide/RawPot/WolfHide require their distinction. Ordinary stone axe is accepted for StoneAxe while cross-axe discrimination is separately unproven.
scoring_policy.threshold: No numerical pass threshold was preregistered for this item-name review; none is invented.
scoring_policy.count_buckets: Reviewers were asked names, not quantity. No count-bucket accuracy claim is made.
